test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_insert_perf_{array_size} ( a Array(UInt64), pos_signed Int64, pos_unsigned UInt64, value UInt64 ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_insert_perf_{array_size} SELECT arrayMap(i -> number + i, range({array_size})), toInt64(number % ({array_size} + 1) + 1), number % ({array_size} + 1) + 1, number FROM numbers(10485760 / {array_size})
test.query: SELECT arrayInsert(a, {array_size} / 2 + 1, value) FROM array_insert_perf_{array_size} FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayConcat(arraySlice(a, 1, {array_size} / 2), [value], arraySlice(a, {array_size} / 2 + 1)) FROM array_insert_perf_{array_size} FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayInsert(a, pos_signed, value) FROM array_insert_perf_{array_size} FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayConcat(arraySlice(a, 1, pos_signed - 1), [value], arraySlice(a, pos_signed)) FROM array_insert_perf_{array_size} FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayInsert(a, pos_unsigned, value) FROM array_insert_perf_{array_size} FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayConcat(arraySlice(a, 1, pos_unsigned - 1), [value], arraySlice(a, pos_unsigned)) FROM array_insert_perf_{array_size} FORMAT Null
